verdict.rationale: Cekura's own SDK offers a documented tracing integration for LiveKit agents ("enhanced/deep observability"), and it ingests call-level transcripts and metadata via its observability API. The evidence never says these traces capture individual LLM calls with inputs, outputs, and token usage; latency appears only as a call-level voice metric. missing for 10: evidence of per-LLM-call trace capture, inputs/outputs at the LLM-call level, token usage tracking, LLM-call latency, framework-agnostic instrumentation beyond LiveKit, independent corroboration
